mapper.select: SELECT model_version FROM rec_huagao_model_version WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY COALESCE(activated_at, trained_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM rec_huagao_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN sys_huagao h ON h.id = r.huagao_id WHERE r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} AND h.status = '审核成功' AND h.type = '上架'

SELECT h.id, h.name, h.photo, h.price, h.fenlei, h.content, h.type, h.shangjiaids, h.status, h.zhekou, h.fujin, CAST(ROUND(r.score * 1000) AS SIGNED) AS search_score FROM rec_huagao_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN sys_huagao h ON h.id = r.huagao_id WHERE r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} AND h.status = '审核成功' AND h.type = '上架' ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
